committee.sub: Morning brief · Wednesday 25 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test credit is now at A$0 (creditRemainingExGst) after 108 raw paid clicks since 6 Oct, and campaignStatus already shows PAUSED; adsChanges shows externalLast24h and externalLast7d both at 0, so the test numbers are not contaminated by outside edits.

Paid spend fell to A$0 last 7 days from A$32.24 prior, with clicksLast7 at 0 versus 5 prior; lifetime spend sits at A$1,977.43 ex GST and the A$600 test credit is fully drawn down, so there is no live cost-per-click signal to assess this week.

Since the test started, ask_cta_click sits at 18 and quick_question_click at 5, but review_cta_click is still 0; the short question form is getting used while nobody has stepped up to the deeper booking step.

eventsSinceStart.generate_lead shows 3 since the test began, against leads.last7 of 0 this week (prior7 was 1); these are unverified enquiry candidates, not confirmed demand, until graded against the qualified rule.

actions.text: The A$600 promo credit is exhausted (creditRemainingExGst is A$0). Apply the decision rule now: keep paid search paused unless cost per qualified enquiry is A$480 or less and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review.
Raw paid clicks have reached 108, past the 75-click checkpoint. Check the test log: if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag fires.
Three generate_lead events have fired since the test started. Check the Formspree and Cal.com emails for source on each and grade them against the qualified rule in the test log.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups are still outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update them to current site stats.
